listingTitle: Avoid repeated Python list membership scans
title: Avoid repeated Python list membership scans
why: List membership is linear, so checking the same list inside another loop can create quadratic work.
suggestion: Convert the lookup collection to a set before the loop when ordering and duplicates are not part of the membership semantics.
limitations: Only variables explicitly annotated as list or List, or assigned a list literal or list constructor, are tracked.
Collection size, reassignment, variable shadowing, and intentionally small lookup lists are not inferred.
